title: Install by invitation
description: Help a friend you invited to install Freedom without lending them your AI (SPEC 7.5). You make an invite code; the friend's setup wizard sends sanitized error reports to your site only after the friend sees and confirms each one; your own agent reads them as data, fixes Freedom or writes an answer, and the wizard fetches the answers. Your AI never connects to the friend's computer; after the friend signs in to their own subscription, their own AI does the rest. A per-invite budget ledger stops at 80 %.
isolationReason: the public intake route runs in the site's PHP; the home tool only calls the site with the push key
